stem: On the $\mathbb{Z} \times \mathbb{Z}$ perpendicular net, $ABCD$ is a rectangle whose sides are parallel to the axes. Its consecutive vertices are $A({=x1}, {=y1})$, $B({=x2}, {=y1})$ and $C({=x2}, {=y2})$. Write the ordered pair that represents the vertex $D$.
solution: $A$ and $B$ have the same second projection {=y1}, so $AB$ is horizontal. $B$ and $C$ have the same first projection {=x2}, so $BC$ is vertical.
$D$ is joined to $A$ by a vertical side, so it has the same first projection as $A$: {=x1}.
$D$ is joined to $C$ by a horizontal side, so it has the same second projection as $C$: {=y2}.
notes: Text-only. Order A,B,C,D consecutive, AB horizontal, BC vertical, so D=(x1,y2) is unambiguous.
